title: Android Wear IOB not available
symptom: The user is using xDrip on their phone and Android Wear (Huawei Smartwatch 2) device. They do not have a pump/loop, so IoB (insulin on board) is important. The value is shown in xDrip on the phone, but they cannot find a way to get it on their watchface.
evidence_quote: I now have informations about my estimated A1c etc as a toast message, but I haven't found a way to get my current IoB!
